_note: EXP-0031 refined/new descriptors for tools/agx-isa/db.json (same schema). Orchestrator merges. Do NOT edit tools/agx-isa/ directly (parallelism constraint).

fields.name: grp
fields._comment: low 3 bits = 0b100. byte0 low nibble observed 0xc and 0x4 (bit3=form/width modifier; does NOT change SR select -- HW-proven).

fields.name: form
fields._comment: byte0 bit3: 1 (byte0=0xNc) vs 0 (byte0=0xN4). Width/datapath form; splicing a 0xc-form SR into a 0x4-form get_sr still reads the same SR (HW-validated).

fields.name: dst
fields._comment: byte0 high nibble = destination GPR low bits (HW-confirmed: hw_ kernels put gid vs builtin in different dst regs matching the store's data reg). High dst bits presumed in the byte+2/+3 suffix (follow-up).

fields.name: sr_sel
fields._comment: SR number = BYTE1 (instruction bits [8:16]). HW-VALIDATED by splice-and-observe (EXP-0031): splicing byte1 in a dispatched out[gid]=SR kernel makes the output become exactly that SR's value (0x82->lane, 0x85->simd_group, 0x98->threads_per_tg=64, 0x9c->threadgroup_pos, 0xa4->pos_in_tg, 0xa0->pos_in_grid). Graphics SR numbers (VS/FS) are byte-diff-derived (same instruction, mechanism HW-validated in compute).

fields.name: suffix
fields._comment: bytes +2/+3. =0x1006 for a plain 32-bit GPR dst in compute; varies (0x1106,0x1026,0x0927,0x0827) with dst-high/type/datapath. Full decode = follow-up.

instructions.semantics: d[dst] = special_register[sr_sel]. Reads a built-in/special register (thread/threadgroup/simd IDs, dimensions; VS vertex_id/instance_id/base_*; FS position/front_facing) into a GPR. sr_sel (BYTE1) is the SR number. Corrects EXP-0010 which mislabeled byte0-high-nibble as sr_sel (it is the dst reg).
instructions.provenance: HW-VALIDATED (EXP-0031): SR number = byte1 proven by byte1-splice on dispatched kernels (raw/splice_validation_compute.txt); dst = byte0 hi nibble proven by hw_ multi-getsr kernels; front_facing (0xc5) proven both-sided via winding flip (raw/render_validation.txt). SR enum: compute from const-addr isolation kernels + splice; graphics from VS/FS isolation byte-diff (raw/getsr_table.txt).

fields.name: imm8
fields._comment: byte1 = 8-bit immediate value moved into dst.

instructions.semantics: d[dst] = imm8. 2-byte move of a small immediate. Shares byte0 low-nibble 0xc with the 4-byte get_sr; distinguished by length (2 vs 4). The compiler uses it for constant-folded built-ins (e.g. threads_per_simdgroup = 32 = 0x20).
instructions.provenance: HW-VALIDATED (EXP-0031): out[gid]=threads_per_simdgroup compiles to `0c 20`; splicing byte1 0x20->0x21/0x40/0x11 changes the output to 33/64/17 (value == byte1 literal, NOT an SR read). raw/splice_validation_compute.txt. NOTE for tokenizer: get_sr (low-nibble c, 4B) and mov_imm (low-nibble c, 2B) collide on byte0; length is disambiguated by the `10 06`-style 32-bit-source suffix present only on get_sr.

sr_number_table._desc: A18 Pro / G17P get_sr special-register number -> meaning. delivery: 'get_sr'=read via get_sr instruction; 'get_sr(uniform-prog)'=read via get_sr in the constant/uniform program; 'computed'=derived by ALU from other SRs; 'folded'=compile-time constant; 'interp'=interpolation datapath (0x2f/0x97), not get_sr; 'mem/varying'=loaded from tiler output (0x07/0xa7).

threads_per_simdgroup.note: constant-folded to mov_imm 0x20; Apple9 SIMD width = 32

position.note: pixel x/y via get_sr; z(depth)/w(1/w) computed/interpolated

sample_id.note: folds to 0 on 1-sample target; delivered via 0x97 path; NOT-YET-CHARACTERIZED (needs MSAA pipeline)

primitive_id.note: 0x1f/0xa7/0x07 flat load from tiler output, not get_sr
